description: [Company & tax] Verify an EU supplier's or customer's VAT number before invoicing or paying. Use when applying the reverse charge or onboarding a B2B counterparty in the EU. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/vat-check

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

vat.description: EU VAT number with country prefix, e.g. DK34223858, DE129273398

name: check_vat
title: EU VAT Number Check (VIES) ($0.02)
